instruction: A compact one-person airship with a riveted brass envelope shaped like a fat cigar, wrapped in leather straps and copper banding. Below hangs a varnished walnut gondola with a bay window, a spinning wooden propeller in a brass ring at the stern, and two exhaust stacks venting from a small boiler. Pressure gauges, valve wheels, and a spidery web of taut rigging cover every joint.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Steampunk Sky Runner in a steampunk style. A compact one-person airship with a riveted brass envelope shaped like a fat cigar, wrapped in leather straps and copper banding. Below hangs a varnished walnut gondola with a bay window, a spinning wooden propeller in a brass ring at the stern, and two exhaust stacks venting from a small boiler. Pressure gauges, valve wheels, and a spidery web of taut rigging cover every joint. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
